title.narrative: El Salvador Mesoamerican Forest IP Project: Promoting forest conservation and integrated water management in Trifinio

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

Support a transformative shift towards conservation and sustainable management of the Trifinio Fraternidad Biosphere Reserve, by promoting inter-sectoral coordination, strengthening institutions on issues related to ecosystem protection and restoration, and promoting deforestation-free livelihoods.

The main objective is to contribute to the sustainable improvement of production conditions; the integration, articulation, management and social inclusion of coffee farmers and families; and the positioning of coffee in the Trifinio Region improving sustainable practices linked with water conservation and improving resilient livelihoods for small farmers in the Trifinio intervention area. Potential income increasing and production practices more cost effectives with an environmental approach will be part of the livelihood improvement in this child project.Gender considerations are included within ‘social inclusion’ targets across the project, as El Salvador’s National Government’s specifically asked to delete references to gender equality and across the document and frame them under a social inclusion agenda that aligns to recent national policies and social frameworks.
